statements.status_notes: Debian marks this issue unimportant with negligible security impact and has no fixed package version: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-25467. The x264 library is present through Playwright's browser media dependencies, so applicability to browser-controlled media remains under investigation rather than being classified as not affected.
